fields.title: LinkedIn company employee record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of LinkedIn company and people data. One COMPANY row per company - always, cookie or not - one EMPLOYEE row per matching person, NOTICE rows explaining any gap, and ERROR rows on failure. LinkedIn changes its markup and private API without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The company URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source surface
_source.description: guest-company-page for COMPANY rows, voyager-search-clusters for EMPLOYEE rows, or none on NOTICE and ERROR rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: fetch_failed, auth_required or employee_search_failed.

_noticeDetail.title: Notice detail
_noticeDetail.description: What the notice means and what to change.

companyUrl.title: Company URL
companyUrl.description: Canonical LinkedIn page, tracking parameters stripped.

companySlug.title: Company slug
companySlug.description: Handle out of the URL - the stable key to join on.

companyId.title: Company id
companyId.description: LinkedIn's internal numeric id. Never rendered on the page, but it leaks in the 'see all employees' call to action - and it is the key the people search facets on, so an employee run cannot proceed without it.

companyDomain.title: Company domain
companyDomain.description: The company's own web domain, derived from their website. Bare domain only: no email address is guessed from it, because a fabricated address that bounces costs you your sending reputation.

website.title: Website
website.description: The company's website as listed on LinkedIn.

employeeCount.title: Employees on LinkedIn
employeeCount.description: How many people list this company as their employer - useful as a sanity check on how much of the organisation an employee run could ever reach.

fullName.title: Full name
fullName.description: EMPLOYEE rows: the person's display name.

firstName.title: First name
firstName.description: Split from the display name with pronouns, emoji frames and credential suffixes removed.

lastName.title: Last name
lastName.description: Last remaining name part after the same cleanup.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: The person's LinkedIn headline - the field the role filter matches against.

matchedKeyword.title: Matched role keyword
matchedKeyword.description: Which of your role keywords this person matched. Null when no include filter was set, so you can tell 'matched everything' from 'matched nothing in particular'.

profileUrl.title: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: Canonical profile link, tracking parameters stripped and country subdomains folded onto www.
